worldcombat.skill.dragonrush.summary: Spread your menace into a visible ring of dread, then dive from above and crash onto the locked landing point: nearby bodies are knocked away and those held by the dread are likelier to flinch. The landing point locks at take-off, so a target that walks out of the airtime dodges it.
worldcombat.skill.dragonrush.use.0: Flash a ring of dread, then dive onto the locked point
worldcombat.skill.dragonrush.use.1: Knock the bodies around the landing point away together
worldcombat.skill.dragonrush.use.2: Freeze a target out of acting with a speed edge
worldcombat.skill.dragonrush.description: The dive deals about %1$s power; accuracy %2$s%%, and the landing point locks at take-off. The target's Defence, type and crits settle on hit.
The wind-up spreads dread %1$s blocks wide, the landing radius is %2$s blocks, and a struck target has a %3$s%% chance to flinch for %4$s.
It rises %1$s blocks, hangs %2$s, and knocks the bodies at the landing point back %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.dragonrush.dread.on: Dread form: dread ring x1.3, flinch chance x1.25 and +4 ticks, but dive power x0.94, accuracy -0.04, +3 ticks wind-up and +8 ticks cooldown — a heavier hold and a blunter crash.
worldcombat.skill.dragonrush.dread.off: Swift form (native): dive power x1.08, accuracy +0.04 and a faster dive, at the cost of a smaller dread ring and shakier flinch.
worldcombat.skill.dragonrush.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.dragonrush.growth.0: From level %1$s the dive rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.dragonrush.growth.1: From level %1$s the dive rises to %2$s and the flinch chance to %3$s.
On: a larger dread ring and an easier, longer flinch, but a lighter dive, lower accuracy and longer wind-up and cooldown — hold them, then crash. Off (default): swift form, crashing harder and truer and diving faster, with weaker dread and flinch.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Dragon Rush prefers the mid range (3..8 blocks); a larger value often still cannot reach.
